  PROBLEM: The hold trust check accepts only OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR associations or the GH_PAT login, so a bot configured in AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN is treated as untrusted. The step then runs hold_skip_plan and exits 0 without writing the hold comment or the ai:blocked label, and without removing ai:planning.
  WHY: The run ends green with no hold written, and the same check in clarify.yml has the same gap. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna said NIT. The highest is used, mapped to high.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:366-370 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A bot set in AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN that has none of the OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR associations and is not the GH_PAT account falls into the untrusted-comment skip. That skip calls hold_skip_plan and exits 0 without writing the hold comment or the ai:blocked label.
  WHY: In that opt-in setup the run ends green with no hold written and no ai:planning cleanup. Planning is still skipped. clarify.yml has the same check, so the fix belongs in both files in a separate change.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/plan.yml lines 366-370. Add HOLD_APPROVER_LOGIN from vars.AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN to the step env and treat that login as trusted. Make the same change in clarify.yml. Estimated lines changed: 3. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:366-370 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold trust check does not incorporate the configured AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN bot.
  WHY: The bot is treated as untrusted unless it holds OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR association. The hold logic then skips or fails to authorize valid automated planning approvals.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:366-372 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The trust check accepts only the three associations or the GH_PAT login. A marker /answer from the AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN bot is therefore untrusted, and the step runs hold_skip_plan and exit 0. No hold comment, no ai:blocked label and no ai:planning cleanup result.
  WHY: The comment never receives the <!-- ai:integration-ref-label-missing:v1 --> marker, so the unblock scan cannot see the hold and the next plan run repeats the same label_missing refusal. The PR mirrors the clarify.yml lines 261-262 pattern, so the fix is a follow-up that changes both files together.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:366-371 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold's trust check does not recognize the configured AI_PIPELINE_APPROVER_LOGIN bot as authorized unless its association is OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, or its login matches the GH_PAT account. The job predicate at 42-49 does accept /answer comments from that bot.
  WHY: When the bot triggers planning with /answer and the resolver returns reason=label_missing, the untrusted-comment branch sets SKIP_PLAN=true and exits successfully. It adds no ai:blocked, does not remove ai:planning and posts no hold comment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
